AI Notes.value: Disability-led self-advocacy and design organization founded by Liz Jackson (2017), US-based (NYC). Curates a list of disabled creatives available to consult and collaborate with brands; runs the WITH Fellowship placing disabled designers into studios for 3-month paid placements (launched NYC 2018, expanded SF 2019); co-created CriticalAxis, a community-built trope matrix analyzing disability representation in media and advertising. Published investigative writing in New Republic (co-authored with Rua Williams): "The Fashion Empire Built on Stolen Ideas" (2023) and "How Disabled People Get Exploited to Build the Technology of War" (2024). Clients and consulting engagements have included Google, New York Times, Twitter, Volkswagen, Squarespace, and others per press. Type: Studio (small mission-driven collective doing hands-on consulting and advocacy). Country corrected US (prior migration value UK was wrong; Liz Jackson and the org are NYC-based).
